products.title: Fetco F004 Paper Coffee Filters
products.description: Fetco F004 Paper Coffee Filters are designed for use with 6000 Series coffee brewers. Each case contains 500 filters, with dimensions of 20" x 8".

products.title: Cleaning & Filters Bundle
products.description: Premium, cone-shaped #4 white paper coffee filters designed for Moccamaster coffee brewers. These filters are made in the Netherlands to Technivorm's precise specifications. They are naturally whitened using a bleach-free, oxygen-based method and are bonded without the use of any chemicals or glues, ensuring a clean taste for your coffee. Each box contains 100 filters.

products.title: AeroPress Paper Coffee Filters
products.description: Exclusively designed for use with AeroPress Original, Go and Clear coffee makers, these paper micro-filters are an essential part of the brewing process. The high-quality paper absorbs bitter-tasting oils while micro-sized holes filter and catch fine particles, preventing them from passing into the cup.

products.title: 12-Cup Commercial Paper Coffee Filters
products.description: Brew delicious, flavorful coffee with these BUNN 12-Cup Commercial Paper Coffee Filters. Made with premium oxygen-processed paper, these filters ensure rich coffee flavor and boast a superior stay-in-place design to prevent overflow and messes. Each filter can brew up to 12 cups of coffee and is designed to fit commercial BUNN coffee machines. The filters come conveniently packaged with 500 per bag and two bags per case, ensuring you have plenty on hand. Their fine permeable holes trap coffee granules, oil, and other elements, resulting in a flavorful and rich pot of coffee.

products.title: Round Paper Coffee Filters
products.description: These Chemex round paper coffee filters are made of a special, thicker paper that ensures the purest flavor in your coffee. They are designed for use with Chemex 6-Cup and 8-Cup coffee makers. Each filter is disposable after a single use and is proudly made in the USA.

products.title: Cosori Juni™ Coffee Paper Filters
products.description: These single-use paper filters are specifically designed for the COSORI Juni™ Coffee Machine to ensure clean and consistent pour-over brewing. Each pack contains 60 filters, available in cone and flat-bottom styles to fit both brew baskets.

products.title: Melitta No. 4 Paper Cone White Coffee Filters 12-Cup 40-Count
products.description: Melitta No. 4 white cone paper coffee filters are designed to deliver a richer, more flavorful cup of coffee. These disposable filters feature microfine perforations that enhance extraction and built-in measure marks (each equal to 2 tablespoons) for consistent dosing. The double-crimped design prevents bursting during brewing, ensuring dependability. They are compatible with Melitta, Krups, Braun, Oster, and other cone-style coffeemakers. This 40-count pack of single-use filters is made in the USA.

products.title: Technivorm MoccoMaster #1 Cup-One Paper Coffee Filters in White (80-Pack)
products.description: Experience superior brewing with Technivorm MoccoMaster #1 Cup-One White Paper Coffee Filters. Specifically engineered for the Cup-One Moccamaster coffee brewer, these #1 cone-shaped filters ensure seamless compatibility and uniform extraction for a cleaner, more flavorful cup of coffee. Crafted in the Netherlands, they are naturally whitened using a bleach-free, oxygen-based method and are bonded without the use of glues or chemicals to maintain the coffee's authentic taste. Each box contains 80 premium paper filters.

products.title: Dowan Pour Over Coffee Dripper
products.description: A handmade ceramic pour-over coffee dripper designed for a traditional, manual brewing experience. It features a V-shaped conical design with an inner wall vertical rib system to optimize water flow and flavor extraction, and a three-hole dripping design for concentrated coffee flow. Made from high-fired ceramic for superior heat preservation and durability, it is dishwasher safe and fits most mugs and carafes.

products.title: Orca Stainless Steel Coffee Dripper
products.description: The Orca Pour-Over Coffee Dripper by Fire Maple is a compact, durable coffee brewing tool designed for single-cup pours, making it ideal for camping, travel, or home use. Crafted from high-quality 304 stainless steel, it offers a shatterproof alternative to ceramic drippers. It features a wide base compatible with mug rims ranging from 2.0 to 3.8 inches and is designed to be used with small cone paper filters to ensure a clean, grit-free cup of coffee.

products.title: BODUM Pour Over Coffee Maker
products.description: About the Bodum Pour Over Coffee Maker with Borosilicate Glass Carafe and Stainless Steel Permanent Filter 34 Ounce Corkr BODUM’s Pour Over coffee maker is the key to making richer bolder coffee from the comfort of your home. Its design-led aesthetic is a stylish addition to any kitchen but it’s the resulting full-bodied smooth tasting coffee with a robust aroma that will win your heart. Made from premium quality borosilicate glass that does not absorb taste or aroma the beautifully shaped carafe is fitted with a permanent stainless-steel filter for truly sustainable brewing. No wasteful paper filters that trap essential oils and flavor just pure flavorsome coffee. Pour over brewing encourages a more mindful start to your day. This innovative fuss-free filter coffee maker is simple to use and gives you ultimate control over your cup of joe. All you need is filter coffee grounds hot water four minutes of your day and a little Bodum magic – and you have all the ingredients for a delicious brew. This is pour over perfected.

products.title: 1.5-Cup Pour Over Coffee Dripper Set With Double Wall Mug & Permanent Filter, 12 Ounce
products.description: The Bodum Pour Over Coffee Dripper Set is a single-serve coffee maker designed for convenience and purity of flavor. It features a stainless-steel permanent filter that eliminates the need for paper filters, ensuring a rich taste. The set includes a 12-ounce double-wall mug that allows you to brew coffee directly into your cup for immediate enjoyment. Its compact design makes it portable and efficient for individual servings.

products.title: Fellow Stagg X Dripper Pour Over Coffee Maker Matte Black: Stainless Steel, Manual, 10 oz Capacity, Paper Filter, Washable
products.description: The Fellow Stagg [X] Dripper is a precision pour-over coffee maker designed for consistency and flavor. It features a vacuum-insulated stainless steel body to maintain the ideal brewing temperature and a flat-bottom design with a unique hole and bump pattern to prevent clogs. The steep walls maximize coffee-to-water contact, and a built-in ratio aid helps users get the correct amount of coffee grounds every time. This matte black dripper is designed to brew one 10 oz cup of coffee and comes with 15 paper filters.

products.title: Pour Over Coffee Maker Set Vintage Ceramic Pour Over V60 Coffee Dripper Set with Paper Coffee Filters
products.description: This vintage-inspired ceramic pour-over coffee maker set is perfect for brewing a delicious cup of coffee at home, in a cafe, or even while camping. The set includes a ceramic pour-over dripper and a 15.8 oz ceramic coffee pot, along with 20 paper filters. Crafted from high-temperature porcelain, the ceramic material ensures excellent heat retention and durability, while also preventing any unwanted odors or chemical tastes from affecting your brew. The natural glaze formation gives each piece a unique, ever-changing texture. Available in a charming retro yellow, this set adds a touch of style to any kitchen. It's easy to use and clean, making it an ideal gift for any coffee lover.

products.title: Bodum Pour Over Coffee Maker
products.description: The Bodum Pour Over Coffee Maker is designed to deliver a rich taste and robust aroma by maintaining the natural oils of the ground coffee. It features a cone-shaped filter for brewing, a glass carafe to hold the coffee, and a stylish wooden stand/filter holder with a leather-like tie for a secure grip. The set includes a black metal dripper, making it an elegant and functional addition to any kitchen.

products.title: W60 Dripper
products.description: The HARIO W60 Dripper, co-developed with world champion barista Pete Licata, is an advanced coffee brewing device designed for exceptional extraction. Featuring innovative W-structure technology, this ceramic dripper evolves the classic V60 design to help home enthusiasts achieve barista-quality coffee. Manufactured in Japan, it uses premium ceramic, polypropylene, and polystyrene materials and is safe for dishwasher use.
